Graphic icons representing students and Teacher's Day cards appear as overlays around him. (3) The scene cuts to a portrait of Confucius and later to a historical black-and-white photograph of a building labeled 'Zhishanyan Xuetang'. narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Presentation of Problem -> Historical Proposal -> Conclusion/CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to provide a humorous and informative historical perspective on why Taiwan's current Teacher's Day (Sept 28) is awkwardly timed shortly after the semester starts, while proposing June 26 as a meaningful alternative related to modern education history. It simultaneously promotes a history course for students.
